allow_instructions: Allow Maven build and test commands (mvn ...)
Allow other mainstream build/test toolchains: pnpm, yarn, go, cargo, uv, pytest, dotnet
Allow running the kit's UI detector: node .agent-kit/ui/detect.mjs ...
Allow running the kit's plan linter: node .agent-kit/planning/plan-lint.mjs ...
Allow read-only inspection commands: ls, cat, grep, rg, find, head, tail, wc, sed -n, javap, jar tf, unzip -l, unzip -p, xmllint
Allow read-only git commands: status, diff, log, show, rev-parse, rev-list, branch, ls-tree, check-ignore, stash list
Allow git add, git commit, git tag, git mv, and git restore
Allow docker info, docker version, and docker wait
Allow peer-harness delegation verbs: codex exec ... and claude -p ... (see /peer-dispatch)
block_instructions: Never run in-place file mutations such as sed -i, perl -i, or shell redirection that writes files (use the editor's file-editing tools instead)
Never run destructive or irreversible commands without explicit user approval, including rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard, and git clean
